caption: The drawing depicts a single, shallow bowl positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The bowl is rendered in shades of translucent blue-green, with lighter and darker variations that suggest reflections and contours. The bowl has a wide, open mouth and gently sloping sides that taper to a narrower, circular base. Concentric, swirling lines run along the inner and outer surfaces of the bowl, adding texture and indicating a glass-like or ceramic material. The artist’s signature, “V.L. VANCE,” is present in small block letters to the lower right of the bowl. There are no additional objects or patterns in the composition.
title: Flat Glass Bowl
